title: 📊 Daily Report: Thu Nov 5, 2026
text:
The swing book closed at $17,512.30. For the week it's down $1,087.51 against Monday's base: the strategies are down $48.24 and the CORE QQQ position is down $1,039.27. Since the merge the book is down 12.53% ($2,508.44), while Indy (the SPY buy-and-hold benchmark) is down 5.85% ($1,171.93), so we're trailing by $1,336.51.

Sunny was the only strategy bot that traded today, stopping out of FANG for −$39.21. CORE also rebalanced once (bought a little QQQ back). Rota and Sunny are the active bots, Trek has no edge, and the rest are benched. There are 3 open positions. CORE QQQ is on with the trend filter (prior close 691.95 vs the 200-day at 679.44). It holds $14,565, which is 83% of the book. Idle cash earned $0.22 in interest today.

Research's analyst note for today:
- Worst day since April 2025: S&P 500 -4.3%, Nasdaq -5.5% (now in correction), Dow -3.5%, as fears of tighter AI rules after the Democratic sweep met soft Qualcomm and Arm results.
- Chips took the brunt: the semiconductor index fell about 12%, with Nvidia -9%, AMD, Micron and Western Digital about -16% to -17%, and SanDisk -22%. Breadth was terrible, roughly 7 losers for every winner on the NYSE.
- Our avoids on semis, memory and Tesla were the right call; the hiding spots were staples and telcos (KO, VZ, PG roughly flat) and oil rebounded.
- After hours, Airbnb jumped about 11% on its report while Cloudflare slipped about 3%.
- Next up: the October jobs report at 8:30 tomorrow is the big swing factor. We stay out of tech and AI hardware until the selling calms and favor defensive beat-and-raise names.
